requirements.text: An active-workspace member can create an HTTP(S) short link with destination URL, title, active flag, and a unique normalized slug.
Generated slugs retry on collision; custom slugs reject reserved application paths.
A link can be placed in one folder.
A link can be scheduled with optional UTC start and expiry timestamps.

A link can require an access code stored only as a Laravel hash; unlocks are link-specific, versioned, valid for eight hours, and rate-limited to five failed attempts per five minutes per link/visitor cache key.
Unavailable links return 404 without creating a click or event record.
A link can select one active custom domain in the active workspace.
A link can select one active CTA overlay in the active workspace.
A final short-link delivery writes a rich event only after explicit tracking consent; the aggregate click counter remains independent.

Link lists support search, filters, tags, safe preview, UTM/custom-parameter building, delivery variants, CSV import/export, and capped bulk actions; mobile cards replace unavailable tables without a misleading view selector, long active-filter values/no-result text stay within the list card, and long destination URLs truncate within short-link cards while preserving full link text.
Link edits retain immutable delivery snapshots and support an optional owner/admin approval workflow.
Existing short-link, bio-link, and link-page item destinations reject LinkPilot default aliases and every claimed custom-domain host.
Published links support guarded direct, splash, local published-page, and LinkPilot-controlled CTA-overlay delivery plus ordered country/device/platform rules.
Bulk actions and CSV import/export preserve workspace authorization and return row-level validation outcomes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Only active-workspace members can view or manage links; mutations and referenced folders, tags, pages, domains, and overlays are checked against that workspace.

Availability, schedule, access code, approval, active/archive state, target validity, and maximum-click checks precede final delivery; stale concurrent requests cannot exceed the configured click limit.

The non-executing preview and final delivery replace every existing occurrence of a configured key, preserve unrelated repeated query values and the fragment, apply non-empty UTM values before non-empty custom values, and use the last non-empty value for each key, including custom over UTM; an empty later duplicate custom row does not erase an earlier non-empty custom value.
No remote frame delivery is exposed; intermediate pages remain LinkPilot-controlled.
Pending revisions are reviewable by authorized owners/admins while the current live delivery remains unchanged until approval; rejection notes and immutable snapshots remain available in history.

CSV import processes rows independently, enforces file-size, row-count, current-workspace reference, and plan/quota limits, and returns bounded row-index/status/error outcomes without echoing sensitive input. Export is deterministic and excludes access-code plaintext and hashes; bulk actions are capped.

Public delivery checks availability, schedule, access, approval, active/archive state, target validity, and click limits before side effects; aggregate count and click row commit atomically, then consented rich events are attempted. Intermediate splash/overlay views create no final click; continuation creates exactly one.

At mobile widths, link lists show cards and hide the table selector; long active search values retain their full accessible filter name while truncating visually, no-result text stays within the empty card, and long destination URLs truncate inside cards while preserving the full destination as link text.

observedBehaviors: Short links are shown in a dense resource list with per-row actions and metrics.
The desktop shell includes a left resource navigation and top search.
Short links are presented as stacked mobile cards with click counts and row actions.
The fixed bottom navigation includes a QR destination, but the visible list state is Short links.
A centred link-creation dialog overlays the links list.
Destination, short URL, title, QR, and advanced-option controls are visible.
A nested Tracking panel exposes UTM parameter fields and custom parameters.
The underlying link-creation dialog remains visible behind the nested panel.
A nested Retargeting panel shows country, device, and platform destination-rule sections.
The underlying link-creation dialog remains visible behind the nested panel.

implementationEvidence.description: A consented public direct-link visit redirected to its destination, incremented one aggregate click, and emitted one link.clicked event.
A zero-link quota account retained the create dialog and rendered its form-level plan limit.
Workspace-scoped tag creation, generated unique slugs, foreign-tag rejection, tag replacement semantics, and tag filtering with serialized options pass focused regression tests.
Created a workspace tag, assigned it to a short link, verified the list chip/filter and edit selection, and confirmed a 390px layout without horizontal overflow.

Phase 5A focused suites passed 84 tests and 834 assertions, covering final-delivery guards and telemetry ordering, ordered routing, revision approval/rejection, CSV/bulk scope, workspace-safe folder rollups, link-page target metadata, and legacy migration/backfill/rollback safety.

A persistent disposable SQLite migration check backfilled click_count from two legacy click rows, set legacy links approved and overlays to their prior explicit mode, preserved link/folder/overlay/click data, and refused rollback after campaign revisions/rules and a click limit were added; SQLite integrity and foreign-key checks passed.
The mobile create-link capture documents the 390px form layout inside the modal, including destination, title, slug, folder, tags, and host controls.

The complete Laravel suite passed 314 tests and 12,845 assertions. Regression coverage verifies claimed-host delivery rejection, stale approval after a host claim, validated list-state preservation through revision review, spreadsheet-safe CSV titles, and explicit overlay delivery mode.

At a 390px viewport, revision history shows the expanded delivery snapshot, preserves validated list state in both the page and shell breadcrumbs, and wraps a full 500-character rejection note without horizontal overflow; the desktop capture shows the complete note.

The complete Laravel suite passed 324 tests and 13,081 assertions after the Phase 5A review fixes, including pending-revision visibility, workspace revision isolation, initial revision snapshots, state-preserving CSV results, review evidence, conditional delivery writes, and link-page/overlay status actions.
